_about: Pops (PRD, "M3 Demand" and "Turnover"). Set by M3-01 for the issues after it to read; each issue that reads a field may change it and says so. Every value here is a starting value with no source behind it, to tune in M3-21, except `childrenLeaveYears`, the one turnover number the PRD fixes. `popSizeCap` is the most people one pop may hold, for a home of density 1, 2 and 3 in order, so a house is one pop and a tower of 1,000 is ten or more (M3-03). `newcomer` is who moves to the city: the share at each education and wealth level, and the share that has children (M3-08). `workerShare` is the share of a pop's people who work, lower when it has children (M3-03). `turnover` holds yearly rates for M3-11, each turned into a chance per pop per game day by dividing by 365. Births and deaths are per person, so a pop's daily chance is the rate times its size over 365, and a tower pop of 100 sees a hundred times a house's. `childrenLeaveYears` is how long a pop has children on average: its daily chance that a child grows up and leaves is 1 over 365 times it, and when that happens the pop loses a person and no longer counts as having children. `replacementsPerPopYear` is per pop, the share of households replaced a year. No prices here, so no source years.
